purpose: Design for how the evaluator independently judges reviewer findings and applies meta-perspectives, and how the main body examines evaluations, advances rounds and cleans up, including the supporting scripts and JSON.
summary: Overview: evaluator works like reviewer but starts from findings, and outputs evaluations that redefine problems (one evaluation may bundle several findings)
Sequence S10-S20: evaluator run, body reading findings/evaluations, counting actionable items, round advance and deletion
Class diagram of body, evaluator, shared and body-only scripts, and JSON files
Evaluator definition: inputs, finding-first reading, five meta-perspectives reflected in evaluation shape, new findings via --new, reason writing, severity and confidence rules
Body responsibilities: critical examination of evaluations, presentation per evaluation, termination judgment, round limit, deletion after reporting
Interim consult measures: no agenda recording, state kept in conversation context, sources of unhandled findings
Evaluation result JSON (evaluate_result.json) structure and guarantees enforced by scripts; finding_id numbering shared with reviewer
Script specs: evaluator wrappers, append_result/seal_result for evaluations, resolve_review_path, count_actionable, advance_round, delete_review, body wrappers
Test design (unit, contract, integration) and open item TBD-001 on whether meta-perspectives actually work
tasks: Implementing or modifying the evaluator agent definition
Implementing evaluation-related review scripts (append_result, seal_result, count_actionable, advance_round, delete_review)
Editing the review skill body steps S10-S20
Reviewing or revising evaluator and evaluation design
Writing tests for evaluator, evaluation JSON and wrappers
Adjusting consult behavior during agenda refresh
title: DES-083 evaluator の独立評価とメタ観点 設計書
